::: {.header-box}
# Pesticide poisoning is a hidden public-health emergency in South Africa

**≈20,960 poisonings · 2,620 deaths · R2.34 billion lost — every year.**

*StatsSA MACOD 2023 (X40–X49 accidental poisoning). Fewer than 1 in 20 cases is formally detected. You cannot manage what you cannot see — so **surveillance is step one**.*
:::

## The problem in one line

::: {.key-stat}
**South Africa is flying blind.** The country detects <5% of poisonings, the response loop is not closed, and the single most lethal product — terbufos — remains freely registered. **Fix detection first, and the rest of the system becomes actionable.**
:::

## Three briefs, three asks — sequenced

::: {.grid-2col}

::: {.option-summary}
### 1 · Detect — Surveillance ★ *(first step)*
**Ask:** Adopt the Surveillance MVP — PIH live dashboard + minimum viable dataset (S1) and NHLS BChE auto-notification (S2). The NHLS→NMC IT feed is already operational.
**Cost:** ~R137,000/yr (+ R80k one-off setup).
**Impact:** Per-case detection **<5% → ~19%** (4.8% → 18.9%; ≈4× uplift) within 12 weeks. Without this signal, Act and Restrict are guesswork.
**Owner:** NDoH-led — NICD · NHLS · PIH.
:::

::: {.option-summary}
### 2 · Act — Coordination ★
**Ask:** Joint NDoH–DALRRD DG circular adopting the Coordination Full Package — NMC closure-of-loop field, structured DALRRD referral, NICD→DALRRD intelligence feed, clinician auto-feedback, joint KPI dashboard.
**Cost:** ~R145,000/yr.
**Impact:** P(loop closed) 1.1% → ~70%; **~957 deaths averted/yr** at scale.
**Owner:** NICD-led, DALRRD partner.
:::

:::

::: {.grid-2col}

::: {.option-summary}
### 3 · Restrict — Terbufos ★
**Ask:** DALRRD adopt Option T2 (Restricted-Use designation + formulation restriction + distributor audit) now, with a **hard-coded 24-month evaluation gate** that escalates to Option T3 (full ban) if attributable serious cases do not fall by a pre-agreed margin.
**Cost:** ~R1–3M/yr enforcement.
**Impact:** Targets the dominant agent in fatal SA paediatric pesticide poisoning (Davies 2023; Sri Lanka natural-experiment evidence). Leverage on household burden ≈ **500 : 1**.
**Owner:** DALRRD Pesticide Registrar.
:::

::: {.option-summary}
### How the three connect
**Detect** generates the evidence the **Act** loop needs. The closed loop terminates in **Restrict** decisions — terbufos is the first product the upgraded system should deliver, not the last. Outcomes feed back into surveillance and prove the system is working.
**Each ask stands alone. Together they are strictly more valuable.**
:::

:::

## Who bears the R2.34 billion

| Stakeholder | Annual burden borne | Share |
|:------------|---------------------:|------:|
| NDoH — public hospitals (UPFS ward + ICU + drugs) | ~R70M | 3.0 % |
| NHLS — laboratory (BChE + GC-MS + repeat chem) | ~R10M | 0.4 % |
| DALRRD — regulator | R0 (lever-holder) | 0 % |
| Individuals — OOP + lost wages | ~R10M | 0.4 % |
| Households / wider society — lost lifetime earnings | ~R2.25B | 96.2 % |
| **Total** | **R2.34B** | **100 %** |

: Audited decomposition. Mortality (~96 %) falls on households via lost lifetime earnings (25 productive yr × R60k median income, undiscounted). The health-sector share is modest in absolute terms but is the only column on a departmental budget line — and the only one a Minister can act on directly. {.striped}

---

## The economics

::: {.recommendation-box}
### ~R280k of operating spend can retire ~R1.5B of preventable burden

**Total annual operating cost (Detect + Act):** ~R282,000 (R137k Surveillance MVP + R145k Coordination Full Package) — less than one mid-grade epidemiologist's salary.
**Modelled burden avoided at scale:** ~R1.45 billion / year (Coordination Full Package; see [Coordination brief §6c](posts/coordination_policy.qmd#what-changes-under-each-coordination-scenario)).
**Stakeholder split of avoided burden:** ~R50M back to NDoH+NHLS budget lines; ~R1.4B to households.
**ROI:** ~**5,000×** on combined Detect+Act operating cost (R1.4B ÷ R282k); ~**1,000×** even on the whole-system operating cost (~R1.2M, which includes induced hospital, lab, EHP, and DALRRD enforcement demand).
**Legal basis:** NHA §90 + existing NMC regulations + Act 36 of 1947. **No new legislation required.**
:::

---

## What we are *not* asking for

- No new legislation.
- No new test, no new reagent contract (S2 is an LIS configuration of an existing NHLS assay).
- No new agency.
- No single point-estimate masquerading as certainty — every figure traces back to [`amua_import_parameters_v4.csv`](amua_import_parameters_v4.csv); open evidence gaps are listed in the [Parameters Hub](parameters_hub.qmd).
